about_the_game:
STORY:​​
2060: An ancient nano-disaster erupts in Antarctica! Leaked doomsday weapons mutate creatures into killing machines, pushing human defenses to the brink. YOU—one of the finest frontline commanders—are urgently tasked with leading the experimental Gen-3 ​​Humanoid Mech Units​​ in a last stand, buying time for civilian evacuation to near-Earth orbit!

​​GAMEPLAY:​​
​​CUSTOM UNIT DEPLOYMENT​​
▶ Build balanced forces or specialize in:
  - Crowd annihilation   - Boss elimination   - Area control

​​WAVE DEFENSE OPERATIONS​​
After repelling each assault wave, requisition from Logistics:
▶ New-generation Mechs & Facilities
▶ Enhancement/Support-type Armaments

​​DYNAMIC TACTICAL REFINEMENT​​
▶ Continuously optimize unit configuration per combat needs

  • Email：3440845368@qq.com

content_descriptors.notes:
"This game contains: 
2D pixel-style gunfire shooting scenes. 
Combat scenes with mutated creatures and robots in poorly lit environments. (note: the appearance of the mutated creatures is not frightening)
Scavenging and evacuating in a desolate city.
Selling of alcohol and the use of virtual biological enhancement drugs."

short_description: In 2060, nanoweapons leaked from an Antarctic ancient ruin transformed Earth lifeforms into deadly bioweapons. As human forces retreat, you—a top frontline commander—are tasked with leading experimental 3rd-gen mech units to defend the most critical zone until civilians evacuate to near-Earth orbit.
